title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Recovery, Resilience, and Self-Reliance - Transition to Self-Sufficiency in Western CAR programme will work in Ombella M'Poko and Lobaye prefectures, Central African Republic. It aims to contribute to Concern Central African Republic’s Food Systems for Food Security thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to ensure sustainable increase in food and nutrition security levels of households at increased risk of shocks. The programme will support over 131,520 people living in extreme poor households, including female, headed households, households with disabled members and internally displaced people. This will be done through increased crop production and diversification, stronger access to market and economic opportunities for poor and vulnerable people, improved access to business knowledge and skills and improved access to finance.OBJECTIVES: Stronger access to market and economic opportunities for poor and vulnerable peopleOUTCOMES: Transitioning toward self sustainable food and health systems in Western CAR
